tagline: Command your squad, board the dropship, and infiltrate hostile sectors in this sci-fi tactical shooter.
description:
**STAR-Tech: Galaxy Infiltrators** opens in Hangar Bay 2, where an armored green dropship waits with its ramp lowered and a starfield glows through the hangar windows. Armored troopers stand ready beside the menu as the tagline sets the tone: *Command. Infiltrate. Neutralize.*

From the main menu you can jump straight into play, pick a mission, visit the Enforcement Barracks, or browse the Robot Database to learn about the machines you will face. A squad panel tracks your Squad Points, current hero (Hale), and difficulty setting, while an Information Updates feed reports that your squad is ready for deployment and a new sector, an Abandoned Freighter, is available.

This build refreshes the game's audio to better match its sci-fi military feel, covering menu music, click and select sounds, shooting effects, and more.
